reasons: § 12.4 binds Customer (our party) with a post-term, 24-month, worldwide restriction on developing, marketing, selling, or acquiring 'any product or service that competes with Vendor' — undefined scope and beyond the 12-month walk-away threshold, so 'deviation' is correctly classified at high severity.

Full deletion of p0046 matches the playbook's preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) and is the minimal edit that reaches it; the paragraph contains nothing else worth preserving, and § 12.3 already affirmatively states Customer has made no non-compete commitment, so no gap is created.

Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the required [Playbook] prefix, explains the change and the § 12.3 contradiction, and correctly offers the fallback (named product, term only, 12 months, internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) without lecturing.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and that no open-ended compete restriction on Customer survives the edit.
